sources.title: Lao eVisa country price calculator API
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The public JSON endpoint is served with valid TLS from the Lao official eVisa domain and returns 162 named country records used by the live fee calculator.

sources.title: Lao Official Online Visa: Information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Lao eVisa site identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as issuer, links its eligibility list, and describes downloading the approval letter before travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Lao eVisa facility is available for these following countries: see list.

sources.title: Lao Official Online Visa: FAQ
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official FAQ defines the passport category, eVisa approval-letter email delivery, validity, stay and designated-port treatment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Only Ordinary Passport is applicable to apply for eVisa.

sources.title: List of countries having reached unilateral and bilateral visa exemption agreement with Laos
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The current 22 December 2025 Ministry of Foreign Affairs PDF is directly downloadable over valid TLS and distinguishes ordinary, official and diplomatic passport agreement categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of countries having reached unilateral and bilateral visa exemption agreement with Laos

sources.title: Department of Immigration visa-category service
sources.officialityEvidence: The public Department of Immigration API responds over valid TLS with visa-category records, but exposes no residual nationality-specific issuance result.

sources.title: Laos international border checkpoints
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Department of Immigration endpoint is accessible over valid TLS and labels port services, but does not map any held nationality to a visa-on-arrival result.
